title: Foot Aids
description: Silicone gel insoles, heel cushions, arch supports, and toe separators for plantar fasciitis, heel pain, flat foot, and forefoot comfort.

products.name: Silicon Gel Insole
features: Medical-grade silicone gel absorbs shock with every step
Full-length coverage from heel to toe for comprehensive cushioning
Contoured arch zone provides gentle longitudinal arch support
Anti-odour surface treatment keeps footwear fresh
benefits: Reduces impact forces transmitted to the heel, knee, and lower back
Relieves plantar fasciitis pain and general foot fatigue
Suitable for occupations requiring prolonged standing on hard floors
Improves comfort in dress and casual footwear without requiring shoe modification

products.name: Silicon Gel Heel Cushion
features: Targeted silicone gel pad covering only the heel region
Central deep-heel cup cradles and centres the calcaneus
Self-adhesive base keeps the cushion in position inside the shoe
Durable gel maintains cushioning properties through extended use
benefits: Directly cushions the heel to relieve plantar heel pain and calcaneal spurs
Reduces impact on the heel during running and walking
Suitable for fat pad atrophy where natural heel cushioning is reduced
Compact design fits in most closed-toe footwear without displacing the foot

products.name: Arch Support
features: Semi-rigid shell supports the medial longitudinal arch
Cushioned top cover provides a comfortable contact surface
Designed to correct mild-to-moderate flat foot and overpronation
Trim-to-fit edges allow customisation for different shoe shapes
benefits: Corrects overpronation to reduce stress on the plantar fascia and Achilles tendon
Relieves medial arch pain associated with flat foot and posterior tibial tendon dysfunction
Reduces fatigue-related leg and lower back pain from poor foot mechanics
Suitable for daily use in sports shoes, work boots, and everyday footwear

products.name: Toe Separator
features: Soft silicone spacers gently hold adjacent toes apart
Flexible material conforms to the natural shape of the toe web space
Washable and reusable for hygienic daily use
Minimal profile fits inside most footwear without discomfort
benefits: Realigns overlapping or drifting toes to reduce bunion and hallux valgus discomfort
Prevents skin friction and blistering between closely approximated toes
Manages hammer toe, soft corn, and interdigital callus formation
Provides gentle passive correction of toe alignment during daily wear
